title: GPT-5 leaked details: what we know about OpenAI's next model

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What might GPT-5's leaked details reveal about the trajectory of AI research and its societal impact?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Current models suggest GPT-5 could have 10x more parameters, better reasoning, and multilingual fine-tuning capabilities.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But such power risks deepfakes, misinformation, and algorithmic bias if not transparently governed and regulated.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are prioritizing alignment training, red-teaming, and open-source verification tools to mitigate these risks.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: A future where AI is trusted, explainable, and used to solve global challenges like climate modeling and disease prediction.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of AI depends on balancing innovation with accountability, ensuring progress benefits all of humanity.
